events.text: St. Augustine, Florida, the oldest continuously inhabited European settlement in the U.S., is founded.
Italy's armistice with the Allies is announced during the Second World War.
London is hit by a V-2 rocket for the first time.
Star Trek premieres on NBC television.
Queen Elizabeth II dies at Balmoral after 70 years on the throne.

deaths.text: Elizabeth II, Queen of the United Kingdom
